record.definition: unit-size-adjusted median resale $psf, Sep 2021–Sep 2023 against Oct 2024–Sep 2026

text.price: $1,496 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 27.
text.record: Prices rose 14% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 18% for developments with similar features in District 27 — about the same as similar developments.
infrastructure: Canberra MRT, about 300 m (straight line to the nearest exit).
Wellington Primary School, about 920 m: 2.6 applicants per place in Phase 2C, 2025. Admission depends on the exact address.
supply: 1 development within 2 km is still selling, with about 25 unsold homes (URA developers' sales, Sep 2026).
text.demand: 75 resales in the last 24 months, in 23 of 24 months.
watch: Resale prices in 2021–23 started well above the district.
text.answer: Right by an MRT station and a popular primary school within 1 km. Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 27.
